channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Anthony Gould (toe) is active for Week 11 against the Texans.
item.description: Gould will play through his toe injury this evening, but he is on a boom-bust WR5. The Colts are playing without both of their starting offensive tackles, and Gould is not a replacement-level starter.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: NFL on Prime’s James Palmer reports that the Colts want their next general manager to have a say in Jonathan Taylor and Daniel Jones’ futures with the team.
item.description: The Colts have faced scrutiny for their decision to keep Taylor and Jones on the roster, rather than trading one or both away for draft picks. Palmer said this is about empowering their next general manager. The team has reportedly compiled a preliminary list of candidates, potentially putting the team in position to make a hire quickly after the season. Stay tuned.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: Hockenson has a chance to return from his wrist injury for the Vikings’ Week 11 game against the 49ers. It would be nice to see him upgrade to full participation tomorrow. If active, Hockenson will likely qualify as a low-end TE1 with six NFL teams on bye this week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: Douglas is still limited despite coming off the Dolphins’ Week 10 bye, but he has a chance to play this week against the Bills. He will be catching passes thrown by Kyle McCord, but with six teams on bye, Douglas is at least in the FLEX conversation this week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Chris Bell (knee) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: Bell reportedly hyperextended his knee last week, hence his day-to-day labeling this week. Bell had been limited from time to time already this year by soreness in his surgically repaired knee. The fact that this is unrelated is actually good news. He has a chance to play in Week 11 against the Bills.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Colts declared CB Sauce Gardner, QB Riley Leonard, TE Will Mallory, LT Bernhard Raimann, DT Jerry Tillery, RT Jalen Travis and CB Charvarius Ward inactive for Week 11 against the Texans.
item.description: Gardner and Ward are the Colts’ starting perimeter cornerbacks, and Raimann and Travis are the Colts’ starting offensive tackles. Losing all four for this game will be consequential. The Texans’ wide receivers and pass rushers should play efficiently in this week’s Thursday Night Football game.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Texans declared Marvin Harrison, EDGE Danielle Hunter, RB Woody Marks, TE Brevin Jordan, C Jake Andrews, OG Wyatt Teller and OT Nate Thomas inactive for Week 11 against the Colts.
item.description: Harrison (hamstring) and Marks (concussion) are both out this week, condensing the Texans’ skill position corps for fantasy football purposes. Both players can be stashed on benches in 12-team leagues, though neither player is a must-stash option. David Montgomery should handle a sizable workload with Marks out.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Ladd McConkey (back) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: The Chargers’ No. 1 wide receiver is tentatively on track to play in Week 11 against the Jets, but ideally he will upgrade to full participation tomorrow. The Chargers have been willing to run the passing offense through McConkey when he is active. He is a WR2, albeit with some re-injury risk, if he suits up.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: Evans has a chance to play in Week 11 against the Vikings. If active, Evans should be in fantasy football lineups. Re-injury risk is possible, but the 49ers have handled this issue smartly. We should have a decent indication as to whether he will make his return by tomorrow evening. Stay tuned.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was limited on Thursday.
item.description: Wicks is stuck in the questionable column, but he still has a chance to play. With QB3 Joe Milton at the helm, Wicks would only be a WR4/5 against the Steelers in Week 11. He does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues.-Nic Bodiford
